author: reek
body: An animated Julia set, as a [Device] compute kernel. One GPU thread per pixel takes its position as the initial z, iterates z = z*z + c for a shared c that orbits a circle with time, and colours by the escape count. The iteration is a tail-recursive helper with float state -> the plug lowers it to a WGSL loop, and the math is real f32 (smooth, unlike the fixed-point Mandelbrot).

author: reek
body: real-sin / real-cos come from Gpu chapter DeviceMath (correct bodies, replaced with hardware ops by the plug); real-from-int is the compiler builtin.
